newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Market takes break after busy day.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Market takes break after busy day.

text.p: After making broad gains during regular trading on Wednesday, share prices held in narrow ranges after the bell rang, traders said.
"There's nothing worth talking about," one trader said, referring to the relative absence of after-hours action.
Allergan Inc was trading near its closing price of 33-3/8, despite a late-afternoon report that it expects earnings for the first half of 1997 to be lower than for the first half of 1996.
Allergan was down 1/8 during regular trading.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 19,400, compared to 133,000 on Tuesday. Session two volume was 3,674,240, while on Tuesday it was 1,481,500.
